verdict: Leads are up this period, but each lead is costing more to acquire.
narrative: You received 128 leads over the last 28 days at $10.87 per lead, all from Meta — lead volume rose 26% week-over-week, but spend scaled up 41% to get there, which means the cost per lead climbed 12% in the same window. The trend has steadied in the past three days, with daily spend and lead pace holding flat rather than worsening. Google Business Profile activity went dark over the last week, cutting off an organic discovery channel that was averaging roughly 8 actions per day in July; we are investigating the cause now. In parallel, 128 leads entered the pipeline this period but none have converted to scheduled appointments, pointing to an intake bottleneck rather than an ad performance issue — tightening that handoff is the priority heading into next week.

cost per lead this period, up 12% week-over-week as spend scaled faster than results

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile went dark this past week — zero organic discovery actions recorded since July 28 after averaging ~8 per day through July.
watch_item.fix: We are actively diagnosing the cause and restoring visibility; GBP actions will be confirmed live before the next weekly check-in.
